paragraphs: PTO payouts on departure are capped at 5 days and paid at the final hourly rate. Floating holidays number 2 per year and expire on March 31 if unused. paragraphs: Support tickets are purged 90 days after resolution. Legal holds suspend all deletion for affected custodians until the hold is released. Encryption keys rotate every 60 days; retired keys are archived for 2 year.

Analytics aggregates older than 13 months are rolled up and the raw events dropped. Access logs are stored for 365 days for security review. Deleted user accounts are held in cold storage for 90 days before erasure.

Backups follow a grandfather-father-son rotation with offsite copies in 2 regions. Email archives persist for 18 months before automatic deletion. The master retention schedule is maintained in the Beacon system.

Data subject deletion requests must be honored within 30 days. Customer transaction logs are retained for 3 years, then anonymized. Financial records follow a 7 year retention to satisfy audit rules. Marketing consent records are kept for 2 years after opt-out.

paragraphs: Rollback decisions for Sev1 require 2 approver on the bridge. Status updates go out every 15 minutes until the incident is resolved.
